title: Establishment of a clinical research database for the analysis of perioperative outcomes in patients with esophageal carcinoma
summary: This study aims to establish a clinical research database for patients with esophageal cancer who underwent surgery at the University Medical Center Göttingen. Existing clinical data from routine care will be analyzed, including information on surgery, complications, hospital stay, and further disease course. The aim is to better describe postoperative outcomes and to investigate possible associations between surgical techniques, complications, and treatment results.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of all patients with esophageal carcinoma who underwent oncologic esophageal resection at the University Medical Center Göttingen between January 1, 2020 and March 31, 2026.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients aged ≥ 18 years with esophageal carcinoma who underwent oncologic esophageal resection at the University Medical Center Göttingen between January 1, 2020 and March 31, 2026 will be included.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients younger than 18 years and patients who did not undergo oncologic esophageal resection for esophageal carcinoma will be excluded. Cases with insufficient or non-evaluable data will also be excluded.
